actions.verb_sequence: glances once at the circled name on her desk roster -> walks down the aisle and kneels beside the child -> pauses patiently for three full seconds while the child thinks
hesitates briefly -> catches the teacher's encouraging nod -> pencils in the correct geometric match

reactions.reaction: sits taller and raises hand eagerly for the next harder question
notes the four subtle channels — warmth, input, response opportunity, and specific feedback — turning a random label into real learning

scenes.recognition_hook: Chosen purely out of a random-number book, a first-grader gets three extra seconds of warm patience at the desk — and jumps fifteen IQ points ahead by May.
